items.headline: Boos rain down from Superdome stands in Saints' blowout loss
items.description: New Orleans quarterback Tyler Shough understood the fans' frustration after the 1-3 Saints dropped a 45-24 decision to the Atlanta Falcons on Monday night, telling reporters after the loss that "we had some opportunities that we didn't take advantage of."

items.headline: Resurgent Falcons score 80 points in two-game winning streak
items.description: The 2-2 Falcons had a combined 16 points, the lowest total in the NFL, through two weeks, but after a 45-24 victory over the rival New Orleans Saints on "Monday Night Football," Atlanta now has a league-high 80 combined points in a two-game winning surge.
